text:
Sam: Quick heads-up — Mosaic onboarding dashboard is showing latency SLO warnings. 98p at ~480ms vs 250ms SLO. Customer asked for visibility ahead of renewal call.
ops-bot: Alert: SLA-monitor triggered for account=mosaic | metric=latency_98p | value=480ms | window=2026-03-20T09:00:00Z/2026-03-20T10:00:00Z
Marta: Oof, thanks for flagging. Is this limited to Mosaic's traffic shape or a broader regression?
Liam: I rolled a batch-size tweak for their route last week — could be KV-cache miss rate interacting with larger batches. Checking logs now.
Cecilia: Customer has renewal call at 2pm PT — they want concrete remediation + whether credits apply.
Rafael: Legal note: if the breach is confirmed within the billing window, we apply pro-rata credits per TOS. We need an evidence bundle (time-windowed metrics + configs).
Marta: I'll assemble the evidence bundle (latency histograms, per-route token breakdown, config snapshot). ETA 45m.
Sam: @Liam can you snapshot the per-route config and the kernel selection/quantization binary sha? need exact artifacts for the bundle.
Liam: grabbing config now. Example curl I ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \\
  "https://console.redwood/api/v1/accounts/mosaic/serving/config" > mosaic-config.json
```
Liam: also pulling metrics: 
```
redwood-cli metrics get --account mosaic --range "2026-03-20T08:50:00Z/2026-03-20T10:10:00Z" --granularity 1m > mosaic-metrics.ndjson
```
Marta: Once I have the metrics I will include a 1-paragraph summary + recommended action (warm cache, reduce batch to 8, canary rollback to previous model variant).
Sam: Do we need a short customer-facing slide for the renewal call? Cecilia, can you draft a 3-bullet slide: incident summary, impact, next steps + credits?
Cecilia: Yep. Drafting now. Send me the numbers and the credit calc.
Marta: Initial look: impact window ~18 minutes peak (09:12–09:30 UTC). 98p=480ms, 99.9p stayed under SLO. Hoping this falls into credit tier 1–3.
Rafael: Keep raw logs and evidence tarball with MD5/SHA256. We need chain-of-custody note for dispute handling.
ops-bot: Evidence bundle prepared: s3://redwood-evidence/mosaic/3520001234-evidence.tar.gz (md5: d131dd02c5e6eec4)
Marta: Uploaded bundle and ticketed: CS-5421. I'll paste the human summary to this thread after verification.
Sam: Also let's add an enablement note to the onboarding playbook with the current tuning defaults so PMs/SEs know recommended batch/cache settings.
Liam: Can we put a temporary guard in routing policy to avoid batching >16 for Mosaic until cache is warmed?
Sam: Good idea. @ops-bot can you schedule a config change (reduce batch to 16) with a rollback window just in case?
ops-bot: Scheduled run: config-change account=mosaic param=reduce_batch value=16 at 2026-03-20T12:30:00Z, dry-run=false, requester=Sam
Cecilia: I'll join the 1:45pm PT pre-call to walk through wording and expected credit outcome.
Marta: Summary (will post in 20m): Peak 98p=480ms between 2026-03-20T09:12:00Z–2026-03-20T09:30:00Z; recommended remediation: warm KV cache, reduce batch to 8 for 4h, canary rollback option. Estimated credit: ~2.3% monthly invoice (calc attached). Link to ticket/dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/cs-5421/evidence
Sam: Action owners: Marta (evidence + summary), Liam (config + potential rollback), Cecilia (customer comms slide), Rafael (credit/legal verification). Follow-up in this thread.
Cecilia: :thumbsup: sending draft slide now.
Marta: Uploaded CSV + short summary to CS-5421; attaching in thread: https://console.redwood/ops/cs-5421/attachments/3520001234-summary.csv
Sam: Thanks all — ping me when slides are final so I can hop on the renewal call if needed :eyes:
